hero_eyebrow: Est. 2008 — Australian food export & supply chain
hero_h1: Marketer and exporter of premium fresh produce and food
hero_h1_sub: — supplying Australian retailers and international markets since 2008.
hero_lead: Bungle Group is foremost a fresh produce business. We market and export premium Australian citrus, table grapes, stonefruit and vegetables to retailers across Australia and internationally — and have grown to supply frozen food, dairy and grocery products to customers across Papua New Guinea, the Pacific Islands, Asia and the Middle East. Family-owned and operating 24 hours a day, seven days a week — from the paddock to the plate.
what_heading: Fresh produce at the core. Everything else built around it.
what_body: Fresh produce underpins everything we do. We supply Australian retailers daily, export citrus, grapes and stonefruit to markets across Asia and the Pacific, and have extended our range to frozen food, dairy and grocery to meet the wider needs of our export customers — all managed with the speed and discipline of a fresh produce business that runs 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
markets_body: Bungle Group supplies retailers, catering operators, hotels, airlines and institutional buyers across Papua New Guinea, the Pacific Islands, Asia and the Middle East.
why_heading: The supply chain infrastructure behind the product range.
why_body: Our own in-country import entity in PNG, an established packing operation, 3PL capability and carrier relationships with ANL/CMA CGM, PIL and Swire Shipping on Pacific trade lanes. Without this infrastructure, 2,800 product lines is just a catalogue.
certs_body: HACCP, FRESHCARE, HARPS and SEDEX certification, and UN Global Marketplace registration. The credentials that retailers, institutional buyers and government procurement bodies require.
cta_heading: Enquire about supply to your market.
